images.caption:
No Exit  — This wrought iron gate in the walled garden at Wallington Hall seems always to be locked. 
I suspect it may always have been ornamental rather than functional.
Anyhow you may not want to go through it regardless as the area just on the outside appears to have become a horse manure dung heap.

images.caption: East facade, Wallington Wallington is a National Trust property and is open to the public. The house itself, noted for its fine interiors, is set in gardens and parkland straddling the B6342 road. There is a walled garden at the east end of the estate, a formal garden by the house, and extensive naturalistic gardens in the style of Capability Brown. There are also several small lakes on the estate.
